title: Ashbury Rewards Co-Brand Card Benefit: Card Reduction on Returned Free Night Awards Nights
content:
A linked Ashbury Rewards co-brand card lowers the protected rebooking price stated on the return record of one of the Free Night Awards returned from a later night of a reservation cancelled after its deadline.

The card reduction is the premier card return reduction when the membership's linked co-brand card is the Ashbury Rewards Premier Card, the standard card return reduction when it is the Ashbury Rewards Card, and nothing when none is linked. It is taken off the protected rebooking price once.

- **Ashbury Rewards Premier Card linked:** 1500 points (premier card return reduction).
- **Ashbury Rewards Card linked:** 500 points (standard card return reduction).
- **No co-brand card linked:** no card reduction.

The linked card is the co-brand card the Ashbury Rewards membership record shows as linked, as reported by the issuing bank.
